messages:
tara (AE): KiteHealth asked today about replacing CompetitorY with Redwood. They want a 2-week POC focusing on API parity (response fields + streaming), billing equivalence for procurement, and proof we won't regress critical clinical intent extraction. timeline: procurement wants vendor decision within 30 days. Any immediate red flags?
dev (SE): I can prototype an adapter. Their API uses a streaming field 'op_chunk' and embeds "diagnosis_code" and "session_id" at the top level of each delta. We'll need to preserve delta ordering and include their metadata keys on our outputs. Do we have sample traces?
tara (AE): They dropped a redacted sample bundle in the shared drive (S3). ~800 convo snippets plus spike load logs. Also included current QPS patterns (spiky, regionally split between eu-west and us-east).
mike (SRE): Two concerns: tokenization mismatch (CompetitorY uses a different tokenizer family, so token counts could be +10-30%), and streaming semantics (their client expects chunked, newline-delimited JSON). We can implement a streaming shim that proxies chunk stream to our streaming API and rewrites chunks on the fly.
lina (Security): From the security questionnaire: mandatory SAML SSO, SCIM for provisioning, KMS with rotation and an audit trail, and a requirement for optional Dedicated or Private deployment for PHI-sensitive workloads. For POC they may accept hosted with an executed DPA + SOC2 evidence. Also ask if we support ephemeral HSM-backed keys for rotation windows.
ash (Finance): Pricing ask: they want an invoiceable model similar to CompetitorY for the POC to avoid procurement friction. We can do an effective per-token rebate using POC credits and a 30% onboarding discount for first 60 days if they sign a 12-month committed baseline for Dedicated. Need estimated daily tokens and peak QPS to craft numbers.
dev (SE): Adapter sketch: lightweight facade service that receives CompetitorY POSTs -> translates payload to /v1/responses, preserves their top-level fields, streams Redwood deltas back and remaps to op_chunk. Pseudocode: 
```
receive chunked POST /competitory/rpc
for each chunk:
  parse -> map messages -> input.text
  call redwood /v1/responses?stream=true
  for each redwood delta:
    attach session_id, diagnosis_code if present
    emit as op_chunk
```
Also: add a response-normalizer to ensure their schema keys exist even when our model omits them (fill with null or best-effort).
mike (SRE): For validation, propose dual-write canary: forward traffic to Redwood and CompetitorY for 72-hour windows, log responses, compute schema diff and semantic drift. We can run the comparator daily and surface regressions. That will add data egress and storage cost (logs for ~2 weeks). I'll estimate infra and egress.
lina (Security): VPC peering / Private option for POC? If they require private interconnect for PII, provisioning adds ~48-72 hours. Also SCIM/SAML integration will need test users.
tara (AE): They also asked about automated rollback if we detect quality regressions mid-POC. Can we provide a fail-open policy that flips traffic back to CompetitorY when delta-failures > threshold?
mike (SRE): Yes, implementable at the proxy: rule-based circuit breaker with metrics (schema_mismatch_rate, eval_fail_rate). We'll need an eval harness and baseline acceptance criteria.
dev (SE): I'll build a small eval harness: input the 300 ground-truth pairs they provided -> compute exact-match for keys + semantic similarity for text fields (embedding cosine). I'll output a pass/fail per sample and aggregate.
nash (Finance): Note: dual-write and egress billing will be a separate cost line in the POC SOW. Also include a credit cap.
infra-bot: Reminder: POC sandbox provisioning ticket #5009 will start in 90 minutes.
tara (AE): Action items: dev -> deliver adapter prototype + sample normalizer by Tue EOD; mike -> infra estimate (sandbox + egress) by Tue noon; lina -> initial security Q answers and diagram by Mon EOD; ash -> draft POC credit terms and estimate line items. 30min sync Tues 11am PT.
dev (SE): ack. I'll also commit a comparator script: `./tools/response_diff --gold=competitory.json --candidate=redwood.json --out=diff_report.csv`
lina (Security): I'll flag EU data residency as potential gating item and ask procurement for their compliance checklist. If they require in-region hosting for PHI, that's a production-only ask but could block Dedicated timeline.
tara (AE): Who can join Tues 11am?
dev (SE): me.
mike (SRE): me.
lina (Security): me.
nash (Finance): tentative.
tara (AE): Great. I'll send the calendar invite and attach the sample bundle + adapter spec draft. Thanks all :white_check_mark:
